about: Pinned downloads (model weights, binaries, archives) for JARVIS. Fetch and verify with jarvis/tools/fetch.py. Values come only from upstream metadata (Hugging Face API lfs.oid, GitHub release asset digests, published checksum files); nothing was downloaded to compute a hash. pip and npm dependencies are locked elsewhere.

roots.oracle-vm: /home/ubuntu/jarvis (not a default: pass --root or set JARVIS_DATA_ROOT)

machines.other-profile: hardware profiles other than this laptop (cpu8, cpu16, vram8plus)

entries.name: llama-cpp-b11714-win-vulkan-x64
entries.notes: Adopted 2026-10-17 in place of b11669 after the Linux release-vs-release comparison (same accuracy, JSON validity and llama-bench speed; jarvis/docs/reports/evidence/08-runtimes-agents-infra-2026-10-17.md). The Windows vulkan build itself is UNTESTED: run the laptop checks before relying on it. llama-cpp-b11669-win-vulkan-x64 stays locked for a rollback.

entries.name: llama-cpp-b11714-win-cpu-x64

The Windows cpu build itself is UNTESTED: run the laptop checks before relying on it. llama-cpp-b11669-win-cpu-x64 stays locked for a rollback.

entries.name: llama-cpp-b11669-linux-x64
entries.notes: The Linux test server's b11669 CPU build today is a local source build (/srv/jarvis/tools/llama.cpp-b11669-cpu holds cmake.log and make.log), not this release binary. Optional until the test server switches to it.

entries.name: llama-cpp-b11714-linux-x64
entries.notes: Release binary used 2026-10-17 to compare b11714 with b11669 release vs release (equal accuracy, JSON validity and llama-bench speed). Needs glibc >= 2.34 (the test image has 2.41) and libgomp.so.1 copied next to it (not in the test image). The test server's default stays a local native source build (/srv/jarvis/tools/llama.cpp-b11714-cpu, BUILD.txt), which is ~8% faster at prompt processing than this generic binary. Optional.
